prerequisites.text: Only trained service personnel should carry out installation, programming or maintenance of this equipment.

refs.quote: Only Trained service personnel should undertake the Installation, Programming and Maintenance of this equipment.

steps.text: Press MENU. Select DISABLE, then OUTPUTS, using the arrows and ✔. If prompted, enter your authorised password.

refs.quote: Press the ‘Menu’ button to bring up the display menu.
refs.section: 3.8.1 Using the Buttons to Navigate Menus

refs.quote: buttons to highlight the required menu option and then press the ✔ button to select it.
ZONE/INPUTS OUTPUTS GROUPS
If the current User ID does not have the necessary permission, the display prompts for entry of a password
Enter the password as normal. Once a valid password has been entered, a pop-up window is shown

steps.text: Highlight ALL SOUNDERS and press ✔. The display returns to the main Disable menu.

refs.quote: highlight the ALL SOUNDERS Option and then press the ✔ button to disable them. The display automatically reverts to the Main Disable Menu.

effects.text: Disabled outputs will not activate for a fire alarm or another programmed event. The available output options depend on how the installation engineer configured the system.

refs.quote: If disabled, the outputs will not activate in the event of a fire alarm or other programmed event.
the available options will have been configured by the installation engineer.

effects.text: The Sounder Disabled indicator illuminates. For some combined sounder/beacon devices, disabling the sounder also disables the beacon.

refs.quote: The ‘Sounder Disabled’ Indicator will be illuminated.
For some combined sounder/beacon devices, the beacon follows the operation of the sounder and it is only possible to disable both the sounder and the beacon together.

refs.quote: disable individual input devices.
3.10.2 Disable - Outputs

steps.text: Press MENU, select DISABLE → ZONE/INPUTS, then scroll to the required zone or enter its number.

refs.quote: Press the ‘Menu’ button to bring up the display menu.
refs.section: 3.8.1 Using the Buttons to Navigate Menus

refs.quote: buttons to highlight the required menu option and then press the ✔ button to select it.
ZONE/INPUTS OUTPUTS GROUPS
buttons to scroll through the available zones, or key in a specific zone number.

steps.text: Move to the Mode column, highlight its existing mode and press ✔. Choose SELECTED INPUTS so the panel lists the input devices in that zone.

refs.quote: move over to the Mode column and highlight the existing mode. Press the ✔ button and a pop-up window appears
If SELECTED INPUTS is chosen, the pop-up window disappears and a list of the input devices within the selected zone is presented.

steps.text: Check the required input against its device information, then highlight that input and press ✔ to disable it. Press Esc to return.

refs.quote: button for more information on the inputs, including full state, type, analogue value etc.
buttons to scroll through and highlight the required input and then press the ✔ button to disable it.
Press the ‘Esc’ button to return.

effects.text: The DISABLE indicator shows when zones, input devices or output devices are disabled.

refs.quote: If any zones, input devices or output devices have been disabled, the DISABLE Indicator is illuminated.

3.11.2 Enable - Outputs

steps.text: Press MENU and select ENABLE → ZONE/INPUTS. The panel lists zones containing disabled input devices.

refs.quote: Press the ‘Menu’ button to bring up the display menu.
refs.section: 3.8.1 Using the Buttons to Navigate Menus

Selecting this option will show a list of zones containing disabled input devices.

steps.text: Select the required zone and individual input to enable. The manual says this display uses virtually the same format as the equivalent Disable menu.

refs.quote: The complete zone, individual devices and other options within the zone can then be enabled (The display format is virtually identical to the equivalent Disable menu).

effects.text: The DISABLE indicator goes off only when all disablement conditions have been removed.

effects.text: Disablement indications clear when the corresponding disablement conditions are removed. The general DISABLE indicator remains until all disablements are removed.

notes: Reviewed panel menu operations only. These do not establish a physical device replacement procedure, compatibility, site permission or completed work.
